text: After this you can distinguish a working draft from an accepted configuration.

A baseline is a specific description that has been reviewed and accepted for further work. It is a reference point, not a promise that nothing can ever change. Teams may agree on overall functions, assigned requirements and detailed instructions for building a particular version. These are often called functional, allocated and product baselines. Their labels are useful only when their owners, approval status and revision are clear.
